<script id="semicon-pilot-cta-tracking-v1">
(function(){
  if (window.__semiconPilotCtaV1) return;
  window.__semiconPilotCtaV1 = true;
  var last = {};
  function params(box, link) {
    return {
      cta_id: box.getAttribute('data-cta-id'),
      cta_family: box.getAttribute('data-cta-family'),
      source_page: location.pathname,
      destination: new URL(link.href, location.href).pathname,
      placement: box.getAttribute('data-placement'),
      cta_route: box.getAttribute('data-cta-id'),
      cta_stage: link.getAttribute('data-cta-stage'),
      cta_type: link.getAttribute('data-cta-type'),
      is_external: false
    };
  }
  function emit(name, box, link) {
    if (typeof window.gtag === 'function') window.gtag('event', name, params(box, link));
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    var link = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('a[data-cta-route]') : null;
    var box = link ? link.closest('[data-semicon-pilot-cta]') : null;
    if (!box) return;
    // The site's older document listener is registered later in the footer.
    // Suppress it for these links so a click sends exactly one GA4 event.
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    var normal = e.button === 0;
    if (e.defaultPrevented || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) normal = false;
    if (link.target) { if (link.target !== '_self') normal = false; }
    if (normal) e.preventDefault();
    var key = box.getAttribute('data-cta-id');
    var now = Date.now();
    if (last[key]) { if (now - last[key] < 1000) return; }
    last[key] = now;
    if (normal) {
      var navigated = false;
      function go() { if (!navigated) { navigated = true; location.assign(link.href); } }
      if (typeof window.gtag === 'function') {
        var data = params(box, link);
        data.event_callback = go;
        data.event_timeout = 800;
        window.gtag('event', 'semicon_cta_click', data);
        setTimeout(go, 900);
      } else go();
    } else emit('semicon_cta_click', box, link);
  }, true);
  function ready() {
    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;
    var sent = {}, timers = {};
    var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
      entries.forEach(function(entry) {
        var box = entry.target, key = box.getAttribute('data-cta-id');
        if (sent[key]) return;
        if (entry.intersectionRatio >= 0.5) {
          if (!timers[key]) timers[key] = setTimeout(function() {
            timers[key] = null;
            if (sent[key]) return;
            sent[key] = true;
            var link = box.querySelector('a[data-cta-route]');
            if (link) emit('semicon_cta_impression', box, link);
            observer.unobserve(box);
          }, 1000);
        } else if (timers[key]) {
          clearTimeout(timers[key]); timers[key] = null;
        }
      });
    }, {threshold: [0, 0.5, 1]});
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-semicon-pilot-cta]').forEach(function(box) { observer.observe(box); });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', ready, {once:true});
  else ready();
})();
</script>

<script id="semicon-news-pilot-dedupe-script">
(function(){
  function ready(){
    var box=document.querySelector('#post-859 [data-cta-id="sc_fuji_pressure_to_cmp_end"]');
    var link=document.querySelector('#post-859 section#scia-next.scia-next a[data-scia-link="next_read"]');
    if (!box || !link) return;
    if (new URL(link.href,location.href).pathname !== '/what-is-cmp-semiconductor-process/') return;
    var section=link.closest('section.scia-next');
    if (section) { section.remove(); box.id='scia-next'; }
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',ready,{once:true});
  else ready();
})();
</script>
